sentences.en: I absolutely adored elephants.
sentences.tc: 我非常喜歡大象。

sentences.en: Then when I grew up and I realized you could see elephants, hang out with elephants and feed them in Thailand.
sentences.tc: 當我長大後，我意識到在泰國你可以看到大象，和大像一起出去玩，還可以餵它們吃。

sentences.en: I dreamed of meeting one. I dreamed of interacting close up with an elephant. sanctuaries are facilities that provide elephants with a safe and natural environment for them to stay. These facilities.
